title: Newsical
subtitle: The day's world and U.S. news, sung. A satirical musical news recap for ages 13+.
description: {title} is a satirical musical news recap for ages 13 and up: a few of the day's most important world and U.S. stories, told through short original songs and character scenes, released weekday mornings in time for the drive to school. The facts are sourced and fact-checked, and every episode links its source ledger and transcript. The jokes and songs are satire. AI disclosure: the music and host voices are AI-generated (songs by the ACE-Step music model; the hosts are synthetic voices, not imitations of real people), the scripts are written with AI assistance, and the cover art is computer-generated.
